topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I don't know what's worse—the silence or the shadow it casts. They said it was all a surprise, that everything was set, the balloons, the cake, the laughter waiting just beyond the door. But now, the door stays closed, the other side as empty as the promise in their eyes when they told me to come, to trust in their plans woven from happy threads that have now unraveled into nothing. I should be relieved, maybe; the world is quieter without the expectation of joy. Yet, the quiet is thick with something unsaid, a promise broken without a word. I stand here, not moving, waiting for a sound that might mean something—anything.
